notes.title: Remote Play is here!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! We're glad to announce that Eye in the Sky now supports Steam Remote Play Together (SRPT)!

With SRPT you can easily play Eye in the Sky and many other co-op games with all your favorite humans around the world. They don't even need a copy of the game!

All you need to do is start up your VR headset and the game, then right click a friend on your steam friendslist and invite them to play together!

Remember, Eye in the Sky is heavily focussed on communication, so make sure to grab a microphone and boot up your favorite Voice Chat service ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Patchnotes v1.1 - Bonus Levels!
notes.content:
Hey everyone, we're back with another patch! And this one is a big one, so let the download roll in, or turn on auto-updates if you didn't receive it yet!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28205068/4da325f4ab78785c0d4843171f1de7e1e4e20048.jpg[/img]

[b]Bonus Levels[/b]
[list][*]We have added a new feature in the menu! The Bonus Levels window allows us to add new levels to Eye in the Sky when we think we've come up with something cool in our spare time![/*][/list]

[b]BL_Amazing[/b]
[list][*]Added the bonus level "Amazing" (obviously)[/*]
[*]developer's note: [i]"Amazing" is an attempt at making something a bit different. It's less escape-roomy like most levels in the campaign and more to the point with only one or two main puzzles. The main goal for me was to make sure both VR and PC would have to communicate a lot to get through this, and I think it definitely works. Can you make it through without losing a single Light to the invisible lasers? :) Muahaha![/i][/*][/list]

[b]Sewers_2[/b]
[list][*]Added a sign to make sure people read the symbols from left to right[/*]
[*]Adjusted the symbol buttons to have the same orientation as the Light's symbols[/*]
[*]Small adjustment to the pipe-jump part at the end of the level[/*][/list]

[b]Sewers_3[/b]
[list][*]The barrel-jump distances across the water have been shortened[/*][/list]

[b]Sewers_4[/b]
[list][*]Added a hidden sign to clarify how the ending of the level should work[/*][/list]


As always a huge thanks for playing our game, and we hope you enjoy the addition of a new level!

~ The VinLia Games team



[i]p.s. Our main designer, Feroxxy, has set up a Patreon page. She'll post ocassionally about her TARDIS VR project, new levels for Eye in the Sky, and new games that are in the making. Check her out at [url=http://patreon.com/Feroxxy]Patreon.com/Feroxxy[/url] ![/i]

notes.title: Patchnotes v1.0.1 - small batch of fixes
notes.content:
Hey everyone, here's a small patch fixing some issues which we found thanks to player feedback! Thanks for helping, and don't be shy to let us know if you walk into problems with Eye in the Sky!

As always be sure to have auto updates on, and if it's not updating just close and reopen Steam to download the latest patch.


[b]Patchnotes v1.0.1[/b]

[list][*]Fixed the Bucket in Tutorial, which wasn't always accepting your cube offerings
[*]Added a short audio notification upon completing Tutorial
[*]Fixed the visual effects of the Buttons in Junkyard_4
[*]The goo showers in Junkyard_5 will kill the Light now, as was intended
[*]Improved the pathing of jumps in Sewers_1
[*]Changed the light puzzle in Sewers_1 to avoid trial and erroring.
[*]The camera of the Light should now clip less while walking through the Sewer tunnels
[*]Other small issues resolved like sound adjustments, water shader fix, invisible wall changes[/list]

notes.title: Patchnotes v1.0 - Oculus Support, New levels, Leaving Early Access
notes.content:
Oh goody, it's here!

As always be sure to have auto updates on, and if it's not updating just close and reopen Steam to download the latest patch.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28205068/bcff815a11c5815f49dbf437d7797ae7742ac489.jpg[/img]

[b]Oculus Rift[/b]

[list][*]We've been testing the game thoroughly and the answer is clear; Eye in the Sky finally is officially playable with the Oculus Rift + Touch!
	[list][*]Trigger is for picking up objects
	[*]Press the joystick to use your pointers[/list][/list]


[b]General improvements[/b]

[list][*]Small story bits are implemented to make the world a little more alive
[*]Slightly increased the Eye's reach
[*]Slightly improved accessibility of some puzzles for shorter humans playing as the Eye
[*]Minor improvements in all levels like hint notes, more props should help avoid getting stuck too long
[*]Buttons now interact with cubes from a bit further away; this should help Eye players avoid cubes flying away because of them being pressed through the button
[*]Removed disclaimer[/list]

 
[b]Level changes[/b]

[list][*]Tutorial
	[list][*]Brand new level introducing the story and some basic puzzle elements![/list]

[*]Junkyard_1
	[list][*]Small story bit implemented
	[*]Slight adjustments to some jump puzzles and button placement
	[*]Fixed various deadspots the Light could get stuck in[/list]
	
[*]Junkyard_2
	[list][*]Small changes to make the puzzles pathing more clear[/list]
	
[*]Junkyard_3
	[list][*]Fixed glossy terrain
	[*]Fixed an invisible wall that would let the Light skip the complete level (whoops!)
	[*]Added a password screen to improve clarity of the symbol puzzle
	[*]Light blips on the map are better visible[/list]
	
[*]Junkyard_4
	[list][*]The Light can now escape the barrel room if the Eye lost the Cubes
	[*]Fixed color puzzle - no more trial and erroring
	[*]Fixed deadspot in the hidden room[/list]
	
[*]Junkyard_5
	[list][*]The Eye can reach a bit further into the goo pool to grab lost cubes[/list]
	
[*]Sewers_2
	[list][*]Added password screen to improve clarity of the symbol puzzle[/list]
	
[*]Sewers_3
	[list][*]Slightly increased the size of barrels; this should decrease the Light slipping off when the barrel floats on water
	[*]Improved the pathing of the overall puzzle
	[*]Can no longer skip a big part of the level[/list]

[*]Sewers_4
	[list][*]Spawning pipes is now limited by a resource. Recycle surplus in the incinerator![/list]
	
[*]Inner City_1
	[list][*]Brand new level introducing lasers, cool color puzzles and a small story finale!
	[*]Inner City takes place after the Eye and Light's escape from the Sewers[/list]

	
[b]Other solved issues[/b]

[list][*]The menu should now always load
[*]Legacy SP achievements are removed (go get your 100% now!)
[*]LevelLoader now Loads Levels fully Loaded as the LevelLoader is intended to Load Levels.
[*]Fixed delay on interacting with cranks[/list]


[b]Final word[/b]

It’s been almost a year since we at VinLia Games started this crazy little project of ours. Eye in the Sky went into Early Access in April and as development continued we learned a lot about what you guys liked and what we wanted to achieve with our game. Your reactions to the game were overwhelmingly positive and we thank all of you for joining us on this development adventure. 
We'll continue to monitor the forum, so if anything goes wrong let us know. But for now, go out there and go have some fun!

~ The Vinlia Games team

notes.title: An Eye in the future #3 - Release imminent
notes.content:
Greetings humans! It has been a while but we're nearly there.

It's already night time here in the Netherlands, but we're working hard to prep for release! The next big patch should drop within a week! [strike]We've crunched the numbers and there is a 99% chance Eye in the Sky's next big patch drops, well, within 24 hours from now![/strike]

This next big patch will bring two new levels, a heap of optimization and bugfixes, and we've retouched some of the levels to make sure they feel slightly more balanced out for both the VR and PC their gameplay.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28205068/70ca2ee3a025bfe26435fd99648f049c99a1c90c.png[/img]

We're also testing the game with Oculus Rift as we speak! There's still some things to iron out (cool new controller models are being created as I type this specially for the Rift Touch controllers!) but we're pretty sure official Rift support through SteamVR is making the cut tomorrow.


Keep an eye out for the patchnotes following soon, and we'll talk more about Eye in the Sky in the future!

~The Vinlia Games team

EDIT: [i]Obviously we should've thought of the possible release timeslots, as Steam doesn't check releases during the weekend. Fear not, EITS is still due this week![/i]

notes.title: An Eye in the future #2 - full release planning and price reduction
notes.content:
Hey everyone. It has been a while since we've posted an update, and while that was partly due to summer holidays, there's also been happening a lot behind the scenes which we felt obliged to update you on.

While it has certainly been enjoyable to work on the Eye in the Sky project, it was very hard to sell this project to the public. You see, VR is already a small market, and then to aim for a niche market within a niche market (the local co-op department) was both a daring and perhaps not the smartest thing to do if part of our group expected to gain atleast enough profit to pay the rent.
With already one person in our team having a fulltime job and the rest finding and applying for new jobs, Eye in the Sky got less and less attention as we simply struggled to find the time.

We are still committed to finish the Eye in the Sky content we're currently working on, but as we're running short on development time we have to make some changes to our planning.

[b]We are going to reduce the price to 9,99,- eur/USD (price may vary in your currency) to reflect upon the changes of the final product we intend to ship.[/b] While we are not capable of reverting the purchases since our early access release, we implore potential buyers to wait till the new price goes live, and we totally understand if you want to refund purchases made in the last few weeks to rebuy for a lower price.
We are really thankful for everyone who has backed us since we went live on Steam, and we're sad we cannot deliver the quantity we wanted.

There will be a patch in the coming weeks which contains a lot of fixes, two levels - including the first level of the Inner City. We will also evaluate and - if everything works - move out of early access. Going forward, Eye in the Sky will effectively become a one man hobby project.

There's still a couple more levels in the works for Inner City, but these may or may not be patched in at a later date, when we simply have the time to do so (Don't worry, there won't be DLC).
The same goes for story content. While the tutorial should give you a bit of an idea why two odd robots decide to solve puzzles together, there probably won't be added a lot more.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28205068/b1254e224fc469241ffb79aa0d15c83988d42bc8.jpg[/img]

Fear not, Eye in the Sky still has plenty of gameplay to offer and we can't wait to see you play around with lasers (and accidentily killing off your little robot friend every now and then, we won't judge)!

notes.title: An Eye in the future #1
notes.content:
As we aproach the two month mark of our early access release we felt it was time to share our thoughts with you on what we're planning for Eye in the Sky.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28205068/2f7f0c4a88cfbffa6b23000a330ffa1f650ebe94.jpg[/img]

Behold! The Inner City. A huge contrast compared to the Junkyard. This is just a glimpse of some of the eye candy we're going to offer you in the next set of levels!

What makes every puzzle game better? Lasers. You're going to explore a high-tech facility with lasers, touch screens and a bunch of the puzzle elements you've already encountered! The Inner City is a direct gameplay and story follow up on the levels that are already in the game.


We're also planning to implement more story content. The "how and why" the Light and Eye team up to solve puzzles and work their way into the robot city will unfold in a "tutorial" level.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28205068/b1e420436f4d42daf439a8e56cb3e1f0e242c6d1.png[/img]

While the new batch of content is still in development, we hope this little sneakpeak will help ease the wait!


We have really enjoyed your enthusiasm so far! Whether it be the gameplay video's on youtube, the approval of your reviews or feedback on the discussion board, we - the VinLia Games team - want to thank you for your support!

notes.title: Patchnotes Eye in the Sky v0.2.4
notes.content:
Hey all. Here's a quick patch trying to get some stability in before summer gets too crazy!

[b]General[/b]
[list]
[*]Disclaimer adjusted to automatically dissapear when the loading of the game is complete
[*]"Restart Level" should now properly restart a level even if the game failed to load the level the first time
[/list]


[b]Single Player[/b]
[list]
[*]Single Player has been removed
[/list]

We're sorry to announce single player is being shelved. This was originally put in to see what people would think of at least having the oppertunity to play Eye in the Sky when none of their friends were around.

However, these singleplayer levels lacked polish and the gameplay we so carefully designed for 2 players wasn't compelling enough in a single player setting in our eyes.

We quickly noticed the majority of people did not enjoy these levels and even worse, some lost appetite to try out co-op - which is what we intended as the main game content from the start.

With feedback clearly showing people really enjoy playing co-operatively with their friends and family we realised it was best to keep working on making co-op as amazing as it can be and build more levels for that - which in turn meant singleplayer would never get enough attention to shine.

We hope you can accept our decision as we try to bring you even more co-op levels soon!

notes.title: Patchnotes Eye in the Sky v0.2.3 - QoL
notes.content:
We're not sitting still, development on the next chapter of levels has started and as always we're squashing bugs left and right! Here's an overview.
As always be sure to have auto-update on, or you'll have to start the download manually.

[b]General[/b]
[list][*]Items grabbed by the Light no longer teleport with it upon dieing and respawning
[*]Starting a new co-op savefile no longer clears your singleplayer progress

[i]comment: Since there isn't a tutorial it seemed a bit too strict to have a fail state, especially if it doesn't add to the overall puzzle.[/i]

[*]Level 3; All symbols are now displayed on ONE sign rather than being split across two.

[*]Level 7; The Energy Cube should now move with the platform. Added an invisible wall so the Light doesn't get stuck in the pipes at the end of the level.

[*]Sewers in general; Camera clipping should now happen less for the Light while walking through pipes.[/list]

notes.title: Eye in the Sky available NOW!
notes.content:
It's been quite the ride but the moment is here! You can now download Eye in the Sky and enjoy the first two chapters of co-op mode together with another human!

We would like to thank everyone who wishlisted the game and who is going to purchase the game in the future. This allows us to focus on expanding the game and making sure that you have even more content to look forward to in the future!

We are going to monitor this discussion board for the coming few days for all your bug reports.

We want to save you the headache and mention the following issue that is going to be fixed ASAP;

Level loading takes really long. Don't click away! It might show up as "not responding", but any level should be loaded within 15-60 seconds. We'll try to get this resolved as soon as we can.


From the bottom of our little mechanical hearts, we'd like to thank you once again for your continued support of Eye in the Sky.

~VinLia Games

notes.title: Eye in the Sky releases 28th of April!
notes.content:
In only 3 days our game Eye in the Sky will be available on Steam!

We've worked hard on this one over the past few months and we hope that you guys will like it.

Get ready to partner up with a friend and work your way through a series of escape rooms in Eye in the Sky!

Eye in the Sky is made up of a series of asymmetrical local co-operative escape rooms made for SteamVR. One player will use the HTC Vive while the other can use keyboard and mouse to solve puzzles together.

Currently in the game:
9 escape rooms spanned across 2 chapters
3 experimental single player levels

Yet to come:
2 more chapters with more custom co-op levels
A dozen more single player puzzles to address the fact that we found it hard to add an extra human to the overal package and keep the price low.
